label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

PAY_WITHDRAW_MIN_CONFIRMATIONS.note: W-withdraw-06: the depth a send out of the platform settles at. Blank outside this profile: every send out refuses pay.withdraw_confirmations_unset.

PAY_MERCHANT_TERMS_VERSION.note: Labelled TEST version of the merchant terms a business accepts before going live.

PAY_MERCHANT_TERMS_URL.note: Placeholder address for the TEST terms. Not a real document.

PAY_KYB_APPLICATION_DUE_DAYS.note: TEST days a business has to finish its verification application. Not an owner decision.

PAY_PRODUCT_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES.note: TEST largest product image, in bytes (500 KB). Not an owner decision.

PAY_CHECKOUT_LOGO_MAX_BYTES.note: TEST largest hosted checkout logo, in bytes (100 KB). Not an owner decision.

PAY_SETTLEMENT_ASSETS.note: TEST list of the assets a business can settle in, so a new business sees a zero row per asset on Balances (J-merchant-07 #1). Not an owner decision.

PAY_CHECKOUT_RISK_BAND.note: TEST operator risk band the hosted checkout routes with. Not an owner decision.

PAY_CHECKOUT_SUCCESS_RATES.note: TEST success fraction smart routing reads for the crypto rail and the TEST bank. Not an owner decision or a measured rate.

PAY_CHECKOUT_RAILS.note: TEST: hosted checkout takes crypto and pushed transfers to the TEST bank, which exists only on the local stack.

PAY_PAYER_NAME_MATCH_RULE.note: TEST rule a bank transfer's sending name is checked under (RC-merchant-09). Not an owner decision; blank holds every bank transfer.

PAY_DESTINATION_HOLD_SECONDS.note: TEST seconds a newly verified payout destination (or a change of one) is held before it can receive a payout (J-merchant-02 #5), short so a journey can wait it out. Not an owner decision; blank refuses verifying or changing a destination.

PAY_PARTNER_FEE_BPS.note: J-merchant-04 #6: our fee rate with the TEST bank on a hosted-checkout payment it takes. Blank refuses pay.partner_fee_rate_unset before the payer is shown where to pay.

PAY_WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_CAP.note: J-developer-10 #2: the most active webhook endpoints one business may hold. Blank refuses pay.webhook_endpoint_cap_unset.

PAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET_OVERLAP_MAX_SECONDS.note: J-developer-10 #5: the longest a rolled endpoint secret keeps signing beside the new one. Blank refuses any overlap above zero (pay.webhook_overlap_max_unset).

PAY_WEBHOOK_RETRY_SCHEDULE_SECONDS.note: J-developer-10 #7, #10: the webhook retry policy, seconds before each retry. Blank sends nothing and the deliveries page says so.

PAY_WEBHOOK_RESEND_WINDOW_SECONDS.note: J-developer-10 #10: how far back a resend or a recovery of missed events reaches. Blank refuses pay.webhook_resend_window_unset.

PAY_WEBHOOK_RETRY_MAX.note: Resends and recoveries per business per window. Blank, with PAY_WEBHOOK_RETRY_WINDOW_MS, refuses pay.webhook_retry_unconfigured.

PAY_WEBHOOK_SENDER_IPS.note: J-developer-10 #6: the sender addresses the receiver guide publishes. TEST: the stack sends from its own machine. Blank: the guide says none is published.
